'''Remmy''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] engineer who was employed in the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]] during the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|occupation]] of [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. Remmy had worked with the combat [[Medic/Legends|medic]] [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Doc]] before his capture, and was more than willing to help Doc and a [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]] break into the factory.
